publicRepositoryProviders.claim: OctoCounts is a free SLOC counter for public GitHub repositories.
sources: frontend/src (all product surfaces render GitHub reports only; /embed/github is the only embed provider)
backend/src/github.rs parse_repo_url rejects non-github.com hosts (test: rejects_gitlab_urls)
publicRepositoryProviders.notes: 2026-09-08: all GitLab support and copy removed from the frontend and public docs, and backend parse_repo_url now rejects gitlab.com URLs (github.rs; local cargo test verified, deployment pending). Storage keeps tolerating historical provider rows. Do not re-advertise GitLab.

privateRepositories.claim: Private repositories are not supported; run tokei locally for private code.

sourceUploads.claim: Source-code uploads are not accepted; analysis always targets a hosted public repository.

accountAccess.claim: No GitHub account access, API token, or sign-up is required.

refSupport.value: branch, tag, or commit SHA; the analysis is pinned to an exact commit SHA
refSupport.claim: OctoCounts resolves the requested branch, tag, or commit and pins the analysis to an exact commit SHA.

countingEngine.value: tokei (open source, Rust); every report carries its tokei version
countingEngine.claim: Counts are produced by tokei, the open-source line counter written in Rust.

defaultIgnoredDirs.claim: These directories are skipped by default.

analysisOptions.claim: Users may ignore additional directories or languages and choose whether docs, tests, or generated files are included.

cacheKey.value: repository + commit SHA + tokei version + analysis options
cacheKey.claim: Results are cached by commit SHA, tokei version, and analysis options, so counting the same revision again reproduces the same numbers.

exports.value: plain text, JSON, and a 1200x630 PNG share card
exports.claim: Reports export as text, JSON, or PNG, generated client-side.

extensions.claim: Browser extensions for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox add a SLOC card to GitHub repository sidebars.
sources: frontend/index.html WebApplication/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD and noscript install links

performanceClaims.claim: OctoCounts downloads the compressed source archive of the requested ref instead of cloning full git history. No speed or size multiples may be stated without a published, reproducible experiment (repository, commit, machine, tool versions, network, cache state, commands).

apiRateLimit.claim: State only that no rate limit is publicly documented; do not promise unlimited use.

privacy.value: no account, no advertising, no personal data collection; public repositories only
privacy.claim: OctoCounts collects no personal data and shows no advertising.
